title: Costi 2007 physiological maximum shear strain at maximum reported ROM

quantity.name: physiological maximum shear strain
quantity.definition: largest regional MSS per unit input x maximum reported lumbar segmental ROM (extrapolated)

source.authors: Costi JJ, Stokes IA, Gardner-Morse M, Laible JP, Scoffone HM, Iatridis JC
source.sample: 9 lumbar disc (vertebra-disc-vertebra hemi-body) specimens (T12-L1 to L4-L5) from 3 male spines; 7 grade 1, 2 grade 2-3

protocol.summary: Discs tagged with radiographic markers (endplates, periphery band, mid-transverse grid of 0.25 mm tantalum wires at +-45 deg); hemi-vertebrae potted; 0.15 M PBS at 4 C; 100 N compressive preload 3 h; 10-min ramp displacements/rotations (mean compression 1.1 mm, lateral shear +-0.7 mm, AP shear +-0.9 mm, flexion/extension +-5.3 deg, axial rotation +-2.5 deg, lateral bending +-4.8 deg), stereo-radiography; 3-D maximum shear strain (MSS) from marker triads/tetrahedra, normalised per mm or per degree; largest regional MSS reported; physiological MSS = largest regional MSS x maximum reported ROM.
how_to_simulate: Apply 100 N preload, then each pure displacement or rotation of the upper vertebra (magnitudes as in protocol)
Compute 3-D maximum shear strain in the disc mid-transverse plane by region
Normalise by input displacement (mm) or rotation (deg); report the largest regional value

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 of PMC author manuscript (text layer; wide table columns re-assembled). 95% CI stored in 'ci95'. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
